SELECT name, cadence, target_per_week, description FROM habits WHERE active = TRUE ORDER BY name;

WITH matched AS (
  SELECT id, name FROM habits
  WHERE active = TRUE AND LOWER(name) = LOWER('{{ $json.tool_input.habit_name }}')
  LIMIT 1
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO habit_logs (user_id, habit_id, note, source)
  SELECT current_user_id(), m.id, {{ $json.tool_input.note ? "'" + $json.tool_input.note.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }}, 'telegram'
  FROM matched m
  RETURNING id, habit_id, completed_at
)
SELECT m.name, i.completed_at,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM habit_logs WHERE habit_id = m.id) AS total_logs
FROM matched m LEFT JOIN inserted i ON TRUE;

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO conversations (user_id, role, content) VALUES
    (current_user_id(), 'user',      $conv${{ $json.message_text }}$conv$),
    (current_user_id(), 'assistant', $conv${{ $json.final_text }}$conv$)
  RETURNING id, role, content
)
SELECT
  (SELECT content FROM ins WHERE role = 'assistant') AS final_text,
  (SELECT array_agg(id) FROM ins)                    AS conversation_ids,
  {{ $('When Called by W1').first().json.chat_id }}::bigint AS chat_id;
